# PPM Cocopeat

> PPM Cocopeat is an MSME & RCMC-certified manufacturer-exporter of premium, lab-tested coir substrates from India — washed low-EC coco peat, calcium-buffered coir, and 5kg coir pith blocks — shipped worldwide to commercial greenhouses, nurseries, hydroponic farms and soil blenders. HS Code 53050040.

## Products
- Washed Low EC Coco Peat Blocks (5kg): EC < 0.5 mS/cm, pH 5.5–6.8, expands to 75–80 litres
- Buffered Coir Blocks, Grow Bags & Slabs: EC < 0.8 mS/cm, pH 5.8–6.5 (calcium-nitrate buffered)
- Unwashed High EC Coir Pith: EC 1.5–2.5 mS/cm (animal bedding, soil conditioning)
